# std/ne

> != : not equal

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/ne.pkg) · translated by [bintables/ne](../bintables/ne.md) · translated by [ctables/ne](../ctables/ne.md)

Not equal: compares two values of the same type and gives a `bool`.

```
print 3 != 3          // false
print "ab" != "ab"    // false: strings compare by content
print p != null
```

Pointers compare by address, strings by content. Infix, precedence 30,
left-associative.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 30, left-associative

```
{left: expr T} != {right: expr T} -> bool
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | expression | `T` |
| `right` | expression | `T` |

Produces: `bool`
